basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Records a change of stock between positions, not the stock balance.
Request, physical execution and ledger posting are separate.
Custody and ownership changes are separate from location changes.
Reversals are new movements, not edits.

may: Record planned and executed movements with evidence.
mustNot: Post authoritative inventory or accounting entries without authority.
Edit past movements instead of reversing.
requiresHuman: Reversing a movement that has been posted to the inventory ledger.

considerations: Inventory records can hide theft or be used to blame workers unfairly.
Recall-relevant lots must be traceable to protect consumers.

properties.reason: A movement is a record of an event; the moved goods carry the physical properties.

items: A movement has an item or lot, quantity with unit, source and destination, reason and time.
Often confused with a stock position, a shipment and a warehouse task.
Unsafe handling of heavy or hazardous items.
